scope: Stock read-only SFTP producer through separately authorized HTTPS agent receipt to independent stock SFTP delivery

environment.postgres_resource_limits: 192 MiB memory, one CPU and task-owned loopback
environment.stock_producer_and_recipient: Separate unprivileged loopback OpenSSH 10.5p1 daemons with independently generated host and client keys and separate source and receiver directories

checks: The registered source pins the OpenSSH host and collection public key. An exact approved workflow reads the ready manifest and stages the named payload under its digest and length.
Preview, queueing, capture replay, source review, offer replay and onward delivery do not add an authenticated connection to the producer.
The sender reviews the original immutable revision over the CLI. The receiving agent cannot review the actor-private source or open its ordinary file path.
Stock curl reads the exact bytes through its separately registered HTTPS view. The receiving identity cannot create an onward offer merely because it received that view.
The owning-copy CLI commits a new revision with exact source lineage. Explicit workflow permissions and operator-provisioned SSH transport are required for ordinary onward approval and execution.
The separate receiver stores the original bytes and a stock SFTP client independently reads them back. Revoking the exact route blocks the queued delivery before contacting the receiver.
After the journey the stock producer refuses a write using the actual producer credential. The original files and directory contents are unchanged.
The custody offer retains unknown business processing and receiver persistence.
